ideas.title: The Minnesota DHS Shakeup: A Sign of Deeper Issues?
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the removal of Shireen Gandhi as commissioner and the leadership changes in Minnesota DHS.
questions: What led to the removal of Shireen Gandhi?
What are the implications of the leadership changes?
ideas.insight: The sudden removal of the commissioner and leadership changes could indicate deeper issues within the department, potentially related to the fraud investigation.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Daycare Center Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the fraud scheme involving 9 daycare centers that received $67 million in funding.
questions: Who are the individuals and entities involved?
How did the fraud scheme operate?
ideas.insight: The investigation into the daycare centers could reveal a larger fraud scheme involving government funding and potentially corrupt individuals or entities.
